<b>Plasmium buds</b> are the budding form of [[Plasmium Cocoon]]s,<ref>[[Alchemist Zylotol]]: <i>"The buds should be ripening as we speak, and the nectar within must be extracted before they reach maturity."</i></ref> found in various places throughout the [[Wormways]]. They were seeded across the area by [[Alchemist Zylotol]]'s assistant, [[Zango]], at the alchemist's request.<ref>Alchemist Zylotol: <i>"Before he went and died, my previous assistant seeded the warrens below with Plasmium buds."</i></ref> [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can destroy the buds with her [[Needle]] or [[Tools]], though they regenerate after roughly four seconds. Striking the buds with the [[Needle Phial]] during the <i>[[Alchemist's Assistant]]</i> [[wish]] permanently destroys them and provides [[Plasmium]].

Destroying Plasmium buds causes nearby vines to wither and turn grey. However, after Hornet completes the wish and rests at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] outside the Wormways, the areas where the buds were previously found become even more overgrown. Additionally, a Plasmium Cocoon sprouts in the alcove where the northern bud was located.

In [[Act 3]], larger versions of Plasmium buds appear throughout the Wormways following the completion of the wish. These buds cannot normally be reached with the Needle Phial, but they behave identically to regular buds when accessed using debug tools, even providing Plasmium.
{{Clear}}

== Location ==
Plasmium buds can be found in the [[Wormways]], detectable through their faint blue glow and the vines that grow nearby.
